## Goal
Prevent concurrent deployment jobs from racing over one application's release directory and lifecycle state.

## Scope
- Add an application-scoped deployment lock or atomic active-operation claim.
- Define behavior for a second deploy request while one is queued or running.
- Make API retries safe with an idempotency key.
- Release locks on success, failure, cancellation, and stale-job reconciliation.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Two concurrent requests cannot deploy the same application simultaneously.
- [ ] Duplicate idempotency keys return the original operation/result.
- [ ] Different applications can deploy concurrently within configured worker limits.
- [ ] Stale locks are recovered safely after process restart.
- [ ] Race and restart tests prove there is no release-path or state corruption.

## Dependencies
- #53
- #54
- #55

## Constraints
Do not serialize all deployments globally; isolation is per application with a configurable global worker limit.

body:
## Goal
Prevent application environment secrets embedded in Compose manifests from being stored or returned as plaintext.

## Why this is needed
The current MVP-1 plan protects SSH private keys, but Compose manifests may contain environment values such as database passwords, API tokens, and signing keys. Encrypting SSH credentials alone does not protect these application secrets.

## Scope
- Separate non-secret Compose configuration from secret environment values where practical.
- Encrypt secret values using the existing versioned AES-256-GCM helper.
- Keep ciphertext out of normal API DTOs and console list/detail responses.
- Decrypt only in the deployment execution path immediately before upload/use.
- Redact secret values from validation errors, deployment logs, diagnostics, and audit metadata.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Database inspection proves application secret values are not stored as plaintext.
- [ ] API responses never include ciphertext or decrypted secret values.
- [ ] Deployment receives the intended values without persisting plaintext in logs or artifacts.
- [ ] Wrong/missing key and tampered ciphertext fail closed.
- [ ] Tests cover secret redaction in errors and deployment output.

## Dependencies
- #029
- #031
- #048
- #056

## Constraints
Do not silently change existing Compose semantics. Document migration behavior for any previously stored plaintext manifests and require a safe migration path.
title: [MVP1-073] Encrypt application Compose manifests and environment secrets at rest
